# Test if freezegun properly handles datetime.now(tz)
import datetime as dt
from freezegun import freeze_time

with freeze_time("2023-10-15 14:00"):
    # What does datetime.now() return?
    print("dt.datetime.now():", dt.datetime.now())
    
    tz = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11))
    print("dt.datetime.now(tz):", dt.datetime.now(tz))
    print("dt.datetime.now(tz).date():", dt.datetime.now(tz).date())
    print("dt.date.today():", dt.date.today())
